invariants: Task-level actions live in the bottom action boundary by default; headers carry title, context, progress and passive status.
A section exposes at most one primary action.
Dialog actions live in the dialog footer.
Focus is visible and not obscured.
Modal focus enters the modal boundary and returns to the invoker on close.
Sticky regions must not cover focused controls or validation messages.
Opening search/filter does not destroy the current work context.
Closing restores prior scroll, selection and draft where the underlying entity still exists.
Search, filter, count and results use the same query revision.
A single-choice step may auto-advance only after an authoritative local selection event.
A redundant Next action is omitted in auto-advance steps.
Back restores the prior selected value without inventing a new workflow state.
UI disabled state is not an integrity boundary.
Every write is bound to a stable entity or work key.
Stale responses may not update a different entity or a newer revision.
Retry must converge or surface a conflict; recoverable input is preserved.
Requested, launched, server-committed and business-confirmed are distinct meanings.
Opening a phone, SMS, email or third-party app is not completion.
Verified completion requires an authoritative receipt when the business process depends on completion.
Mobile is not a scaled desktop.
Reading order and task priority remain stable across layout changes.
Bottom actions include safe-area padding and remain reachable with the virtual keyboard.
Ordinary one-dimensional content reflows at high zoom.
WCAG 2.2 AA is the minimum conformance target.
Native semantics are preferred; custom widgets implement equivalent APG semantics.
Meaning is not encoded by color alone.
Touch, pointer, keyboard and assistive input reach the same business outcome unless modality is intrinsic.
Canonical values remain locale-neutral while presentation and parsing are localized.
Language and text direction are explicit metadata.
Logical start/end layout is used for directional layout.
Long translated copy may wrap without hiding required meaning or actions.
A visible file-picker action is always available; drag and drop is an enhancement.
Each file has independent validation/upload/result state.
Preview never substitutes for authoritative file validation.
Remove, retry and cancel are keyboard reachable.
Critical information remains inline and is not toast-only.
Loading, empty, error and populated states are distinct.
Status announcements do not steal focus.
Busy is not success.
IME composition events do not trigger destructive validation, submission or auto-advance.
Virtual keyboards must not hide the focused field or task action boundary.
Input modality does not change completion semantics.
